title: AdaptRouter: Continual Learning to Route across Evolving Tasks and Models
scope: Archived research manuscript tables. Reported point estimates; no new training or model calls.
api_cost_note: List-price cost of selected successful expert answers; excludes training, judges, router compute and unknown failed-attempt invoices. Router-R1 uses the documented conservative high-side comparison policy.
open_cost_note: Parameter-weighted input/output token proxy relative to Qwen3.5-9B (thinking); not dollar cost or wall time.
training_note: Main and continual experiments use feedback-based policy optimization. The API extension uses full-information soft targets with lambda=0.02 and tau=0.05.
coverage_note: Open and API suites are different test sets; their averages are not directly comparable. Max-effort reference rows are partial external results, not complete matched local runs.
continual_note: Each stage trains on new data only. Curves show reported per-task accuracy, not an average across a changing task set.
ablation_note: Full model trained on one GPU, ablations on eight. The evaluation includes the documented 400-question training overlap; it is not a wholly independent held-out test.
precision_note: Numbers reproduce displayed table precision. Narrative summaries are not used to overwrite explicit table cells.
